thread:
sara_sales: Hey team  large early-stage customer wants a 60day POC that needs Private (VPC) access + dedicated throughput. They're in a YC batch but also need SOC-aligned controls. Asking for $30k in free credits to cover the POC and some SRE hours. Can we fast-track an exception?
chen_se: Quick Qs  what's the expected token volume and model family? gpt-style or an open LLM? Any streaming/low-latency needs?
sara_sales: They'll run a chat assistant + embeddings for search. Estimate ~12M tokens total over 60 days, spikes during demos. Prefer Llama-variant quantized, but open to our curated models. Latency SLO: <400ms typical.
sam_engineer: For VPC + dedicated we'd need a reserved Dedicated pool + keying. 12M tokens is fine but spikes matter  recommend a burst policy and prefix cache. Also: will they require KV persistence or long context?
sara_sales: No long KV persistence, mostly short sessions. Only data residency + KMS.
james_dealdesk: For precedent  our typical startup program caps free credits at $15k for hosted trials. Exceptions require RevOps + Sales Ops approval and a manager OK. If this is a YC startup with good traction we could consider a one-time uplift but need ask: are they committing to a paid onboarding after the POC?
sara_sales: No firm commit yet  they want to evaluate infra and security. They said likely to move to Dedicated with a small monthly commit if POC goes well.
maria_revops: We'll need company registration + DUNS or other proof for program exceptions. Also need to confirm they meet startup definition (revenue < $1M or <18 months since founding). If they qualify I can greenlight a conditional uplift.
james_dealdesk: Proposed path: conditional approval for $20k credits to cover Private setup + 60 days, tied to a 3month trial SOW and a conversion play: 3month commit at $2.5k/mo if they convert. Requires RevOps sign-off + Sales Manager OK. Any objections?
sam_engineer: Technical note: Private deploy setup will take ~5 business days for VPC peering + KMS integrations. Need SRE time allocation (estimate 2 engineer-days). Can we include that cost in the credit usage?
maria_revops: We can allow SRE hours to be billed against the credit pool, yes. We'll require a short MOU: scope, exit terms, and data handling notes. Also need security questionnaire answers  can you ping Security if they request our SOC docs?
sara_sales: I can get their incorporation docs today and push security Qs to eng-security. Please confirm if $20k conditional is doable so I can update the customer.
james_dealdesk: I'm ok to approve the $20k conditional credit pending RevOps verification and AM manager sign-off. I'll draft the special terms: 60day POC, credits expire at end of POC, conversion target discount outlined.
maria_revops: I'll review docs when you share. If they meet the startup criteria I'll add the uplift and sign the MOU.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: #PROJ-5421 "YC-startup POC  Private + credits" assigned to sam_engineer and infra oncall. ETA 5 business days.
sara_sales: Awesome  thanks all. I'll assemble the docs and circle back with security Qs. :thumbsup:
james_dealdesk: Thanks  please add the expected token profile and demo dates to the ticket so we can finalize SLOs.
sam_engineer: Will add load profile to PROJ-5421 tomorrow.
maria_revops: Once I verify eligibility, I'll post final confirmation here.
sara_sales: tagged: @maria_revops @james_dealdesk  aiming to get customer a yes by EOD Wed.
